relationships.subject: LAT1
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results indicate that pregabalin transport across the BSCB is mediated at least in part by LAT1 and is inhibited by plasma BCAAs.

relationships.subject: branched-chain amino acids
relationships.evidence_quote: In the in vivo study, the transfer of pregabalin to rat spinal cord and brain was significantly decreased by the pre-administration of branched chain amino acids (BCAAs), which are endogenous substrates of LAT1.

key_findings: Pregabalin crosses the rat BSCB at least in part via LAT1 and is competitively reduced by plasma BCAAs.
